biography: I am an executive level energy asset management professional with 25+ years of experience investing, repowering and enhancing value of power generation facilities. Proficient in the acquisition and development of gas and renewable generation assets, including leading due diligence teams, negotiating purchase and sale agreements, as well as integrating acquired assets and workforce. Expertise in the full spectrum of commercial and operations management with portfolio P&L responsibility and creating value through strategic financial, technical and market based initiatives. Skilled leader of cross-functional teams in executing complex projects and transaction structures. Powerful blend of technical and financial problem solving acumen. Domestic and international experience within Latin America and Europe. Areas of expertise include: • Renewable and gas fired power technologies and operations • Experience in various regional power markets • Investor and Board level presentations • Critical Thinking and Ability to Distill Complex Issues • Cross-Functional Team Leadership • Managing Relationships with Stakeholders and Partners • Executing Acquisitions and Divestitures • Integrating Acquired Assets and Personnel • P&L and ROI Responsibility • Commercial Risk Management
